newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks stable in slow trade.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks stable in slow trade.

text.p: Croatian stocks were mostly stable, with some slight gains on Wednesday.
* Two of six traded issues rose, three were flat and one fell.
* Volume lower at 7,095 shares, turnover also down at 7.1 million kuna. Full results available on page ZAGSTOCK.
* Top gainer hotelier Istraturist inched up five kuna to 130, with 175 shares changing hands.
* Most actively traded, Zagrebacka Banka, was the only loser, edging down 10 kuna to 980, on volume of 6,264 shares. -- Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
